kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتمئر (form IVq)
# نَتْمَئِرُّ (natmaʔirru) /nat.ma.ʔir.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِتْمَأَرَّ (itmaʔarra)
# نَتْمَئِرَّ (natmaʔirra) /nat.ma.ʔir.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِتْمَأَرَّ (itmaʔarra)
# نَتْمَئِرِّ (natmaʔirri) /nat.ma.ʔir.ri/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِتْمَأَرَّ (itmaʔarra)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
